name: CheckboxGroup
purpose: Lets users choose zero or more options from a small, visible set of independent choices.
neverUseFor: A single independent on/off choice — use Checkbox alone instead
Mutually exclusive choices — use RadioGroup instead
Large option sets or anything needing search — use a multi-select instead
rationale: CheckboxGroup renders a native fieldset/legend around independent Checkbox inputs, so the group label is announced for free (1.3.1). It inherits Checkbox's single 16px control unchanged and is meant for small visible sets; anything large or searchable belongs in MultiSelect.

mayExtendLocally: Define the options, legend and helper text per usage
Choose a vertical or horizontal arrangement from the documented props
mustEscalateToDS: Adding search, select-all or other large-set behaviors

authored.name: disabled
authored.description: The whole group, or an individual option, is non-interactive.

authored.name: required
authored.description: At least one value must be selected before form submission.
authored.aria: Announced as a visually hidden "(required)" in the legend — role="group" does not allow aria-required. Not set on each checkbox: native required there would demand every option be checked.

anatomy.description: Root element — groups the legend and options for assistive tech.

Accessible group label. Sits exactly 8px above the options — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

The required indicator (*) inside the legend, text/danger, 2px (spacing/3xs) after the text — shown by `required`. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).
Layout wrapper for the option list. Each option renders a real `Checkbox`.

Helper text for the whole group. Sits exactly 8px below the options — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible group label, rendered as the fieldset's legend.

props.name: options
props.description: The list of choices. Each option: { value, label, description?, disabled? }.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Selection change handler — receives the full updated set of selected values.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction of the option list.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every option in the group.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the group as required (at least one selection).

props.name: name
props.description: Native checkbox name shared by every input, for form serialization. Auto-generated if omitted.

height.note: No size prop exists — each checkbox control is one fixed size (16px), inherited unchanged from Checkbox. Does not follow the ADR-004 field scale.

keyboardNav: Tab — moves focus between options and into/out of the group

focus.note: focus is drawn by Checkbox — see their a11y.applied.focus

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: required
properties.description: Shows the danger * (checkbox-group-required) after the legend,  2px apart; text/disabled when disabled.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Show/hide part: indented 24px (16px box + 8px) to line up with the option text.

properties.name: errorMessage
properties.description: Show/hide part: same indent; code shows it instead of the description.

figma.structure: checkbox-group (8px gap) > checkbox-group-legend,  checkbox-group-options (12px gap,  real Checkbox instances),  description,  error. Options are a fixed sample of three — options[] has no Figma property.
figma.variantCombinations: 6 variants (2026-10-20): orientation vertical/horizontal × invalid false/true,  plus disabled for each orientation (valid) — the standard rule for disabled. No state axis: hover/focus live on each Checkbox option (pattern group). invalid/disabled pass down to every option; disabled dims legend,  required * and description (text/disabled).
